summary: Use fixture files to load pre-generated data when mocking device output or complex external library data; Python placebo can help simulate APIs.
questions: How can I feed recorded device output into a unit test?
What tool helps mock API responses in Ansible unit tests?

answer_card.title: Use fixture data in unit tests
answer_card.answer_md: To fake results fetched from devices or complex data from external libraries, store pre-generated data as **fixtures** and read it in your tests (see `CPU_INFO_TEST_SCENARIOS` for an example). For simulating APIs, Python **placebo** can help.
